programme.title: 47 Ronin - A Grande Batalha Samurai
programme.desc: Nada menos que 47 samurais sem líder prometem vingança depois de um traiçoeiro senhor da guerra lhes ter morto o mestre e os ter banido. O bando de Ronin procura agora a ajuda de Kai um mestiço que eles haviam rejeitado enquanto enfrentam um mundo de bestas míticas e bruxarias assombrosas.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Cano Serrado
programme.desc: Na região Centro-Oeste do Brasil, uma vasta ecorregião de savana tropical chamada Cerrado, o sargento Sebastião fará tudo para vingar o seu irmão, um caminhoneiro morto brutalmente, mas confunde dois policiais da cidade com os suspeitos do crime.

programme.title: Cmon Cmon
programme.desc: Quando a irmã de Johnny, um jornalista de rádio, lhe pede para cuidar do seu filho de nove anos, ele vai embarcar numa viagem pelo país com o enérgico sobrinho para lhe mostrar como é a vida fora de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Um Reino Unido
programme.desc: No fim da década de 1940, o príncipe herdeiro do Botsuana apaixona-se por uma mulher britânica e branca. A união não agrada à política de apartheid de Daniel Malan, e tanto a África do Sul como o Reino Unido farão tudo para impedir o casamento, mas o amor pode falar mais alto que o dever.

programme.title: O Amor E A Vida Real
programme.desc: Dan Burns é um colunista, especialista em aconselhamento familiar, mas com dificuldade em sobreviver como irmão e como pai viúvo de três filhas precoces. As coisas tornam-se ainda mais complicadas quando Dan descobre que a sua apaixonada secreta é na realidade a nova namorada do irmão

programme.title: Shenandoah - O Vale Da Honra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra Civil americana, um fazendeiro da Virgínia jurou permanecer neutral no conflito, mas quando o seu filho mais velho é feito prisioneiro pelos soldados da União ele é forçado a agir.

programme.title: O Quadrado
programme.desc: Christian é o respeitado curador de um museu de arte contemporânea de Estocolmo, que tenta montar uma polémica instalação enquanto se encontra numa crise pessoal e profissional.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola
programme.desc: John Kimble é um polícia de Los Angeles que tem de se infiltrar numa comunidade como professor de um jardim infantil para localizar a ex-mulher do perigoso criminoso que ele quer colocar atrás das grades.

programme.title: Regresso Ao Futuro Parte II
programme.desc: Marty e Doc viajam até 2015 para resolver alguns problemas com o futuro da família McFly. Mas quando regressam, apercebem-se que a realidade de 1985 que conheciam foi completamente alterada. A única esperança agora é regressar a 1955 para conseguir salvar o futuro.

programme.title: 47 Ronin - A Grande Batalha Samurai
programme.desc: Nada menos que 47 samurais sem líder prometem vingança depois de um traiçoeiro senhor da guerra lhes ter morto o mestre e os ter banido. O bando de Ronin procura agora a ajuda de Kai um mestiço que eles haviam rejeitado enquanto enfrentam um mundo de bestas míticas e bruxarias assombrosas.

programme.title: Aeroporto
programme.desc: Mel Bakersfeld é o responsável pelas operações do Aeroporto Internacional de Chicago, que tenta manter em funcionamento durante uma devastadora tempestade de neve, ao mesmo tempo que um bombista suicida ameaça rebentar um Boeing 707 em pleno voo.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia 3 De Volta Aos Treinos
programme.desc: Os alunos do comandante Lassard regressam à Academia de Polícia para treinar novos recrutas e prevenir o encerramento da escola.

programme.title: Kickboxer 2 O Regresso
programme.desc: Um ano depois de Kurt Sloane derrotar Tong Po no torneio de kickboxing, o seu irmão David Sloane, que se esforça para manter à tona uma academia de kickboxing em Los Angeles, é forçado a entrar no ringue para uma luta de desforra contra Po.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Os irmãos JP e Mikey tiveram uma infância complicada. Atualmente, o primeiro é dono de uma empresa de construção mas o segundo é um pequeno mafioso, que é raptado pelo criminoso Eddie King. JP vai arriscar tudo para resgatar o irmão, que sempre fez tudo por ele.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Sofia é uma acompanhante de luxo que trabalha em casa e apresenta-se aos clientes como Manuela. Jano é seu cliente e apresenta-se como Hugo. Quem são Sofia e Jano Nenhum deles é quem parece ser

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Kamal é um jovem belga de origem marroquina que decide partir para Raqqa para ajudar as vítimas da guerra na Síria, onde é forçado a juntar-se a uma milícia. Em casa, o seu irmão mais novo torna-se uma presa fácil para recrutadores radicais, que lhe prometem que irá reunir-se com o irmão.

programme.title: The United Way
programme.desc: A história lendária de uma das equipas desportivas mais icónicas de todos os tempos, o clube de futebol Manchester United, desde as suas origens humildes ao colosso com mais de 650 milhões de apoiantes em todo o mundo.

programme.title: In Memoriam
programme.desc: Harriet é uma reformada com a necessidade de controlar tudo o que se passa à sua volta, incluindo o que virá escrito no próprio obituário. Para isso, contrata uma jovem Anne, para lho escrever ainda em vida para que ela o possa aprovar, o que vai dar origem à mais improvável das amizades.

programme.title: O Melhor Ainda Está Para Vir
programme.desc: Depois de um grande mal-entendido, dois amigos de infância, cada um convencido que o outro tem poucos meses de vida, decidem abandonar tudo e recuperar o tempo perdido.

programme.title: Aeroporto
programme.desc: Mel Bakersfeld é o responsável pelas operações do Aeroporto Internacional de Chicago, que tenta manter em funcionamento durante uma devastadora tempestade de neve, ao mesmo tempo que um bombista suicida ameaça rebentar um Boeing 707 em pleno voo.

programme.title: Negócios De Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas

programme.title: Um Dia De Mãe
programme.desc: Com o Dia da Mãe prestes a chegar, as vidas de várias de mulheres de diversas idades vão cruzar-se, não só na relação que têm com as próprias mães como também no seu próprio papel de mães.

programme.title: Fortaleza Segurança Máxima
programme.desc: Semanas após o mortífero ataque ao Campo Fortaleza, Robert faz uma ousada tentativa para resgatar a viúva do seu antigo inimigo Balzary. E enquanto um novo ataque ameaça a estabilidade daquele espaço, Robert é obrigado a encontrar-se com alguém que nunca mais esperava voltar a ver...

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: Um Herói
programme.desc: Rahim encontra-se preso devido a uma dívida que não conseguiu pagar. Durante uma saída precária de dois dias, tenta convencer o seu credor a perdoar-lhe uma parte da quantia, mas as coisas não correm como esperado.

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: Entrevista Com O Hitman
programme.desc: Viktor é um assassino profissional romeno de elite, que fingiu a própria morte para mudar de vida mas cujo passado o vem perseguir e pôr em risco todos os seus planos.

programme.title: Traidora Americana O Julgamento De Axis Sally
programme.desc: Mildred Gillars é uma cantora a atriz americana que transmitiu propaganda nazi aos seus compatriotas durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial. Apelidada de Axis Sally pelos soldados americanos, esta história verídica estende-se à sua captura e ao seu julgamento por traição no pós-guerra.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Mahler - The Youth Wunderhorn
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Beethoven - Quintet for piano and winds, Op. 16
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, Op. 16. The piece, completed in 1796, is assumed to have been modelled on Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Donizetti - Don Pasquale
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours and the Choir of Opéra de Tours in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s comic opera Don Pasquale (1842). Featuring a cast of the most famous singers of the day, Don Pasquale premiered at the Parisian Salle Ventadour in 1843. It was an immediate success, being performed in the great opera houses of Europe within a year after its premiere.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration - I
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi And Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Janácek - Violin Sonata
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Akiko Suwanai and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Leoš Janácek’s Violin Sonata.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Septets by Mozart and Beethoven
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present two septets in this engaging 2020 concert, recorded at Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland. It opens with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 11 in D major, K. 251, known as the ‘Nannerl-Septet’. Mozart composed it in 1776, probably on the occasion of his sister Maria Anna’s name day, whose nickname was ‘Nannerl’.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: The award-winning Imperial Ice Stars are 26 Olympic, World, European and National Championship skaters, who jointly hold over 250 competition medals, performing theatrical ice dancing on a frozen theatre stage.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: Handel at Chambord Castle
programme.desc: This 2016 concert at Chambord Castle in France under the direction of Hervé Niquet features 70 musicians that gave a spectacular performance of Handel‘s Water Music and Music for the Royal Fireworks. In between Le Concert Spirituel also plays Concerto Grosso’s No. 4 and No. 5 also by Georg Friedrich Handel.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Wagner - Parsifal Act I. Prelude
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Delibes – Coppélia
programme.desc: A classic French ballet, Coppélia was choreographed in 1870 at the Opera de Paris, drawing inspiration from the evolution of society and the choreographer’s imagination. Featuring 40 dancers, the action takes place in the America of Fred Astaire, Gene Kelly, and Jérôme Robbins and echoes the style and spirit of Broadway musicals and Hollywood fantasies.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 2, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 2 in E-flat major, Op. 120.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
programme.desc: Renato Palumbo conducts the Orchestra and Choirs of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s La forza del destino (The Force of Destiny). Verdi and his librettist Francesco Maria Piave based the work on a Spanish musical drama by Angel de Saavedra, ‘Don Álvaro o la fuerza del sino’. Composed for the imperial Russian opera in St. Petersburg, La forza premiered there in 1862.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Nazaré
programme.desc: Na Nazaré, a feira mistura-se com o vento, sal e com o som do mar. É uma extensão da vida piscatória, mas também uma celebração da terra e da fé. Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 80
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 62
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 63
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Os Inocentes T1 - Ep. 67
programme.desc: Uma garota comum se muda para um apartamento de uma família rica, cada uma com sérios problemas psicológicos e obsessões. Eles serão capazes de curar um ao outro?.

Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, Cuban pianist and vocalist Roberto Fonseca performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: John Lewis: Piano Solo
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Bad Ass And Blind
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Hackensack
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Art Blakey And The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: In pursuit of the 27th man
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: SummerJazz Leiden
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a 'Solo Piano Summit,' audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The 'Solo Piano Summit' brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Skylark
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Weather Update - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here.

programme.title: Omar Sosa - Quarteto Afrocubano
programme.desc: While always keeping one foot firmly anchored in the traditions of his home country, Cuba, Omar Sosa tirelessly explores music from the Caribbean to India, and West Africa to the Arab world. Since he left Cuba in 1993, the pianist has been blending his Afro-Cuban roots with jazz, hip hop, electro and world music.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Reckless Smile: Sazz Leonore
programme.desc: With her relaxed, bright voice, vocalist Sazz Leonore has made her name on the Dutch jazz scene. Lorrèn grew up in a family of music fans: from a very early age, she developed a fondness for the music of her great jazz heroine, Billie Holiday and Ella Fitzgerald. In this ‘Reckless Smile’ concert, which was recorded at Amsterdam’s North Sea Jazz Club, the vocalist knows how to entertain the audience.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part II
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kurt Elling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Buana, Buana, King Kong
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: The Jig - Live in Rio
programme.desc: The Jig is a seven-piece funk team from Amsterdam that performs hot original works. It is one of a handful true funk groups; an instrumental groove machine with a rock And roll attitude, known for its powerful and exhilarating live shows.

programme.title: O. Peterson Trio and S. Grappelli - Grand Gala
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s, the annual Grand Gala du Disque was the awards ceremony during which the Edison Awards were presented to Dutch and international artists. These prestigious events were landmarks in the history of Dutch music broadcasting.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of 'neo-boppers' that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: Nasheet Waits - K-Kelli Sketch
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Mestrinho - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: J.E. 'Cannonball' Adderley live in Switzerland
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: Coleman 'Hank' Hawkins: Belgium 1962
programme.desc: Coleman Hawkins: Live in '62 presents two incredible concerts featuring stellar European and American legendary side-musicians including Harry ‘Sweets’ Edison on trumpet and drummer ‘Papa’ Jo Jones. Coleman Hawkins, ‘The Father of Jazz Saxophone,’ demonstrates why he is still considered one of the most important innovators in the history of jazz.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Classic Meets Jazz
programme.desc: Tzimon Barto, the young American classical pianist and Wolfgang Dauner, the internationally renowned German jazz pianist join their talents to show how multi-dimensional music can be.

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions.

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.desc: Em 2015, Tiffany Boyer envolveu-se numa situação tensa numa festa, em Albuquerque. É dada como desaparecida e ninguém fala, mas um detetive descobre uma conspiração de vingança.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Uma dançarina é baleada em casa e os detetives tentam descobrir quem teria motivos para a matar. Um cigarro encontrado no local do crime pode dar respostas.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Uma mãe desaparece de casa e a suspeita recai nos seus admiradores. Será que uma confissão-surpresa resolve o mistério?.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Após o desaparecimento de Amy, a Polícia tem um suspeito, mas não tem uma cena de crime, um corpo, ou pistas. Mas, graças a um inesperado informante, o caso é resolvido.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Um astro do basquetebol e a sua namorada desaparecem quando velejavam. A Polícia tem de localizar o irmão do jogador, que é a única pessoa que pode saber o que se passou.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Na cidade de Ocala, na Florida, um adolescente é vítima de um jovem psicopata, de uma ex-namorada vingativa e de alguns dos seus amigos delinquentes.

programme.title: Chris Brown: A History Of Violence T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Chris Brown tem sido elogiado pela sua inovação e talento. Porém, aconteceu algo que mostrou ao mundo um lado muito mais negro do músico.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Em 2015, Tiffany Boyer envolveu-se numa situação tensa numa festa, em Albuquerque. É dada como desaparecida e ninguém fala, mas um detetive descobre uma conspiração de vingança.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Depois que a doce e insegura Kelly Bullwinkle é encontrada morta num local remoto, os investigadores descobrem uma trama de ciúmes e mentiras entre as amizades.

programme.title: Suspicious Minds T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Aquilla Flood, de 17 anos, é encontrada morta no quarto. A família é confrontada com duras perguntas, enquanto os amigos de Aquilla mencionam o nome de três jovens à polícia.

programme.title: Suspicious Minds T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A morte a tiro de um vereador municipal enfurece os políticos e o público. Muitos suspeitos são considerados até um homem misterioso contactar a polícia.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Agora, já adulta e a viver sozinha, Natalia causa devastação ao perseguir novos vizinhos. Além disso, o lado secreto dos Barnett vem à tona quando se deparam com a investigação.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Agora divorciados, os Barnett, abandonam Natalia num apartamento, no Indiana. À medida que a polícia vai investigando mais, a confissão chocante de Michael leva-a à sua detenção.

programme.title: The Devil Speaks T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Michelle Despinasse é alvejada na sua casa e acaba por morrer. No seus últimos momentos de vida, ela conseguiu fazer uma gravação, revelando o nome do seu assassino.

programme.title: The Devil Speaks T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A Doutora Margo Prade é mortalmente alvejada no estacionamento do seu consultório em Akron, Ohio. A Polícia descobre que o telemóvel dela tinha uma escuta.

programme.title: Where Murder Lies T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Um popular residente em Eastman, na Geórgia, desaparece misteriosamente. Enquanto as buscas aumentam, a polícia faz uma horrível descoberta e concentra-se num suspeito improvável.

programme.title: Where Murder Lies T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em Tallahassee, na Flórida, a comunidade fica chocada quando uma mãe e os três filhos são brutalmente assassinados. Quem poderia ter sido responsável pelo crime horrendo?.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: No Michigan, várias unidades policiais respondem a um tiroteio num parque de estacionamento. Quando chegam, é uma corrida para salvar a vítima e encontrar o atirador.

programme.title: 911: Did The Killer Call? T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Uma mulher liga para o 911 após encontrar a mãe com uma faca cravada no peito. Será uma filha enlutada, ou a chamada serva abafar algo?.

programme.title: Dead on Arrival T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Tim deixa a sua cidade natal para se juntar ao cenário musical vanguardista do Oregon. Mas quando consegue emprego num clube, aprende que o rock tem um lado negro.

programme.title: Dead Silent T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Doug e Rozina Anderson decidem passar o fim de semana nas pacíficas florestas do Norte da Califórnia. Mas a sua escapadela romântica revela-se um erro fatal.

programme.title: Game Day Murders T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Patrick Dennehy, jogador de basquetebol da Universidade de Baylor, desaparece. A verdade é mais chocante do que se poderia imaginar.

programme.title: 911: Did The Killer Call? T2 - Ep. 5

programme.title: L'amour Est Dans Le Pré
programme.desc: L'amour est dans le pré revient avec une 21? saison qui fait le choix de placer chaque agriculteur au cœur d'une aventure qui lui ressemble. Quatorze agriculteurs, âgés de 24 à 64 ans, venus de toute la France et porteurs d'histoires aussi différentes que touchantes, se lancent dans cette quête de l'amour.

programme.title: L'amour Est Dans Le Pré
programme.desc: Karine Le Marchand retrouve les héros de l’année passée pour un moment plein de nostalgie et de joie, où l’amitié et l’amour continuent d’écrire leur belle histoire... Les agriculteurs de la saison 19 se retrouvent autour d’un moment de fête et d’émotion, à l’occasion d’un événement très spécial : les 70 ans de Gillou, doyen emblématique de la saison, ainsi que l’anniversaire surprise de Pascal pour ses 60 printemps.

programme.title: Scènes De Ménages
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

La 118 intervient lorsqu’une demande en mariage de haut vol est contrariée par le braquage d’une banque. L’équipe porte également secours à une future mariée coincée dans son carrosse juste avant la noce. Athena offre son soutien à une femme dont le mari vient de s’éteindre à leur domicile…

Alors que la station spatiale internationale est gravement endommagée par des débris, Athena et Hen doivent risquer leur vie pour réparer un bras robotique et permettre le retour de l'équipage sur Terre. En parallèle, des flashbacks révèlent un ancien drame qui a marqué Athena et façonné son sens du devoir et du sacrifice.

programme.title: Scènes De Ménages
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

programme.title: Patron Incognito
programme.desc: Direction Envia Cuisines, un réseau en pleine expansion qui bouscule le marché en concevant des cuisines adaptées à tous les budgets, grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé et des solutions techniques sur-mesure. Fondée en 2009 et rachetée en 2017 par Jacques Bedun et Patrick Grange, l’enseigne a connu un essor fulgurant : de 7 magasins à 34 aujourd’hui, avec un chiffre d’affaires de 50 millions d’euros en 2024 et plus de 10 000...

programme.title: Patron Incognito
programme.desc: Patron Incognito s’invite chez Buffalo Grill, une institution du repas en famille que beaucoup de Français ont connue en grandissant. Robert Guillet, à la tête de l’enseigne depuis 2022, échange son costume de dirigeant contre celui d’un chauffeur de bus en reconversion pour se fondre, incognito, parmi ses équipes.

programme.title: Tesouros Perdidos Do Egito T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Ao aventurarem-se no coração de uma pirâmide ainda inexplorada, equipas de arqueólogos descobrem novas provas do incrível engenho dos antigos egípcios.

programme.title: Tesouros Perdidos Do Egito T6 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Escavações revelam como os primeiros faraós do Egito unificaram o território e lançaram as bases de uma das maiores civilizações da História.

programme.title: Tesouros Perdidos Do Egito T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Equipas de arqueólogos investigam a antiga luta pelo poder entre o Egito e os seus vizinhos núbios, que chegaram a governar durante 100 anos.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Insufláveis gigantes conseguem fazer toda a diferença na feira. Mas levem-nos para o mato e as pessoas conseguem dar-lhes usos espectaculares.. ou melhor, abusos. Ao menos estão a usar capacetes pois tudo o que sobe, tem de descer. Embora esteja muitas vezes associado com o México, crê-se que os chineses usassem pinhatas há mais de oitocentos anos atrás.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Um programa que mistura ciência pura e dura com alguns dos vídeos amadores mais loucos, espectaculares e dolorosos de sempre está de volta para uma terceira temporada. Richard Hammond introduz uma série de novos percalços com vários bravos e oblívios indivíduos de todo o mundo e depois explica a ciência por trás do seu falhanço e humilhação com o uso de animações sugestivas e cinematografia em super câmera lenta.

programme.title: Sabores Caseiros, Sabores Sem Igual Com Antoni Porowski T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Antoni ajuda Florence a explorar as origens da paixão da sua família pela comida enquanto viajam por Oxford, pela costa de Yorkshire e por Londres. Juntos, encontram pratos deliciosos e descobrem histórias de antepassados cujos meios de subsistência deram início a esta paixão pela comida que transcendeu gerações.

programme.title: Sabores Caseiros, Sabores Sem Igual Com Antoni Porowski T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Antoni leva Issa à terra natal do seu pai, o Senegal, onde descobrem histórias ancestrais de mulheres poderosas e ligações reais. Através desta viagem culinária, Issa aprende mais sobre a história épica da sua família e sobre como tudo se relaciona com a sua própria identidade.

programme.title: O Melhor Do Mundo Com Antoni Porowski T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Antoni organiza as experiências mais memoráveis de Londres, desde a gastronomia multicultural de Brick Lane a um mergulho em Canary Wharf. Desvenda o segredo do funcionamento do Grande Relógio do Big Ben, prova um assado de domingo com um toque inovador, sobe ao topo do The Shard, explora os Jardins de Kew e mergulha na cena drag de Londres com os artistas que lhe dão vida.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A Primavera avança e os residentes de Port Protection encontram tarefas e desafios. Primeiro, Gary, farto da mesma comida, decide sair e tentar algo que não faz há muito tempo (e nunca sozinho): apanhar camarões. Entretanto, Timbi embarca numa viagem para encontrar uma planta medicinal chamada de Ginseng do Alasca para ajudar Hans com as suas dores mas arrisca encontrar ursos pretos esfomeados a acordar da hibernação.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Chegou a primeira e os residentes de Port Protection completam construções e tarefas essenciais. Primeiro, Hans e Timbi tomam um enorme passo para realizarem o seu sonho de ter uma quinta funcional ao construirem um local para patos. A comunidade junta-se para erguer a estrutura de 5 metros e para garantir a segurança dos patos.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Gary Muehlberger faz uma incursão em busca de mantimentos até Wrangell, no Alasca, Hans e Timbi Porter pedem-lhe para trazer uma carga muito importante (patos) que toda a comunidade anseia. Enquanto Gary está em Wrangell, Hans e Timbi pedem ajuda aos vizinhos Mary Miller e Amanda Makar para os ajudar a terminar a casa dos patos a tempo para a chegada de Gary.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Hazen Audel parte para realizar o sonho de toda uma vida de fazer uma caminhada pelo lendário Grande Vale do Rift, na África Oriental. Talvez na maior “meca” da vida selvagem a nível mundial, Audel fará uma viagem de 800 quilómetros através de uma natureza selvagem diversificada na época de migração, sobrevivendo ao ar livre entre animais raros e magníficos.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Na segunda etapa da sua viagem através do Grande Vale do Rift, Hazen desce a íngreme parede ocidental do vale em busca de uma venerada manada de elefantes. Aproveitando as capacidades de sobrevivência de uma tribo local, dirige-se a um grupo de pescadores que conhecem bem os elefantes. Com a ajuda deles, segue a manada até às margens do rio Kerio.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Nesta parte do safari africano extremo de Hazen Audel, ele enfrenta o grandioso Lago Baringo. O seu objetivo é vislumbrar milhões de flamingos migratórios.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Hazen Audel viaja até ao desfiladeiro de Hell’s Gate em busca do rinoceronte negro. Forrageiros florestais enviam-no para uma rede de grutas profundas em busca destas criaturas magníficas.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T10 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: As Operações Aéreas e Marítimas em St. Thomas perseguem uma embarcação em fuga para águas das Ilhas Virgens Britânicas. A Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras interceta uma mãe e uma filha a contrabandear droga através do Aeroporto Internacional de Miami.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T10 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A Guarda Costeira dos EUA interceta mais de 13000 quilos de cocaína e entrega os contrabandistas às Investigações de Segurança Interna para julgamento. O Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras encontra armas durante controlos de moeda à saída no aeroporto de Dulles.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T10 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A Guarda Costeira dos EUA e as Investigações de Segurança Interna seguem suspeitos de tráfico de pessoas na Florida. No Texas, o Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras inspeciona camiões de carga e descobre mais de 200 quilos de cocaína habilmente escondidos em rolos de plástico.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T10 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: As Investigações de Segurança Interna descobrem cocaína escondida num veleiro proveniente da Colômbia. Um cão K9 estreante no Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras deteta grandes quantidades de droga e material associado num dos aeroportos que servem Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Conhecido pelos seus restaurantes sofisticados de renome, a coragem de Gordon Ramsay é posta à prova quando ele luta contra as paisagens implacáveis do Luisiana para aprender os segredos da culinária Cajun tradicional. Primeiro, encontra-se com Eric Cook, um ex-fuzileiro naval que se tornou chef, que o envia para o pântano.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A coragem culinária de Gordon é posta à prova durante a exploração da ilha remota de Sumatra, onde o chef irá trabalhar como marinheiro em alto mar, aventurando-se num sistema de cavernas assustador. Chegará mesmo a ordenhar uma búfala muito irritada.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Deixando para trás o conforto dos seus restaurantes sofisticados, o Chef Ramsay mergulha na floresta tropical da América do Sul para explorar as raízes culinárias do Guiana. Após saltar de helicóptero para a selva densa, o Chef caça jacarés com as próprias mãos, pesca piranhas com uma cana de bambu e prepara a sua própria flecha para pescar aruanã.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O Chef Ramsay embarca numa viagem pelo Sul da Índia numa tentativa de desvendar os sabores complexos da cidade capital do comércio de especiarias do mundo.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O Chef Ramsay recorre ao Viking que há em si para suportar as baixas temperaturas da Noruega em Dezembro e descobrir os sabores difíceis de definir da culinária local.

programme.title: Caixa-Forte Da América - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Seja em moedas, notas ou ouro, todos sabemos que o dinheiro faz o mundo girar. Mas o que nos irá demonstrar o anfitrião Jake Ward neste especial é o motor que permite engrenar a máquina. Pela primeira vez, o National Geographic leva-o ao coração da máquina do dinheiro e a sítios onde não pode entrar com câmara.. directamente aos cofres com algumas das maiores quantidades de dinheiro do mundo..

programme.title: Bastidores: Caça Ao Submarino De Cocaína - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Este especial leva-o até à zona onde equipas da DEA segue as rotas destes novos submarinos, de forma a impedir que sequer iniciem viagem. Ao longo da história, serão mostrados novos dispositivos tecnológicos desenvolvidos de forma a combater esta ameaça, e como é que alguns dos membors da DEA conseguem recolher informação importante nalgumas das prisões mais seguras da Colômbia..

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Em Newark, agentes aduaneiros procuram um carro de luxo roubado prestes a ser enviado para o estrangeiro. Na Florida, intercetam três embarcações suspeitas de envolvimento no tráfico de mercadoria ilegal.

programme.title: Engenharia: Aprender Com A Catástrofe T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A energia nuclear pode abastecer cidades sem emitir carbono, mas os seus riscos pairam de forma marcante na memória pública. Ainda assim, está entre as fontes de energia mais seguras, reforçada pelas lições de Chernobil, Fukushima e Three Mile Island. Estas falhas guiam os engenheiros em direção a um futuro mais seguro e à busca pela fusão nuclear.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Um olhar mais aprofundado pelas mais variadas marcas do mundo inteiro, e uma incrível viagem através da linha de montagem em cada uma destas autênticas Mega Fábricas.
